candidates.title: Beyond Accuracy: Prefix-Invariant Realizations of Low-Precision Fast Matrix Multiplication
candidates.abstract: Fast matrix multiplication saves multiplications through exact cancellation, but rounding sums that mix token rows can leave contributions from later tokens in earlier language model outputs. This threatens prefix invariance, which multiple-choice likelihood scoring relies on: a scored likelihood must depend only on its allowed prefix. On Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct, two fast FP8 realizations repaired to ordinary-looking accuracy still change the answers chosen by likelihood on 5.83% and 10.00% of 240 OpenBookQA items when only the text after the allowed prefix is replaced with the bf16 model's own greedy continuation. Both row-local controls, the bf16 model and a deployed FP8 matrix multiplication kernel, change none. Accuracy thus does not certify prefix invariance, and the stability criteria we analyze cannot tell realizations apart: across all 512 sign variants of two-level Strassen they stay constant while teacher-forced perplexities span a 772.4$\times$ range on the same model. We therefore construct certified realizations of two-level Strassen on bounded integer codes that quantize token rows independently, then mix and cancel exactly before rescaling, using 49 block multiplications instead of 64. Our certificate guarantees bitwise equality to a prescribed row-local classical int8 operator at the same quantization specification, so every certified realization inherits its prefix invariance. Certification thus turns realization choice into a pure cost decision: which certified realization runs can no longer change a single scored likelihood.
candidates.reason: LLM推論のlinear layerにおける低精度・高速行列積の数値実装を扱い、丸めでtoken row間の混合が残るとprefix invarianceが崩れ、likelihood評価とpacked-request servingへ影響することを示す。推論カーネルの効率と正しさに直接関係するためaccept。
candidates.library_body_check: arXiv HTML v1の本文を確認（2026-10-04）。§1と§3ではQwen2.5-14B-Instruct/OpenBookQA 240問で、accuracyを回復した2つのFP8実装でもgreedy continuationへの置換時に回答が5.83%/10.00%変わり、bf16とrow-local FP8 controlは0%と報告する。§3.2、Appendix Cでは5モデルのwindow試験でrepaired実装のnext-token予測が7.8–15.2%変化し、768 packed-request対の分布もunrepaired/repaired #2では全対で変化する一方controlsは不変。§3.3ではQwen2.5-14B-Instructの512 sign variantsが同一の係数安定性指標でもWikiText-2 perplexity比1.367–1056.0に広がる。§4はbounded integer codes上で2-level Strassenを構成し、量子化条件を満たすとclassical int8演算とbitwise一致し、49 block multiplications対64を保つ証明と実験を示す。§4.4では4モデルでcode bound 31のNLL差は3モデルでdeployed FP8 kernelを上回り、overflow correctionを加えたbound 127では4モデルすべて同等以下。評価範囲はモデル/データセット別に記載される。§5ではNVIDIA H20上の4096x4096行列で現行Triton kernelがclassical int8より遅く、one-level Strassenは2.04–3.17倍、two-levelは27.9倍と報告し、性能化・補正kernel・他shape/GPUでの測定をfuture workとする。従って乗算数削減は示すが、推論レイテンシ改善は未実証。

candidates.title: QuLoC: Photonic Quantum-Assisted Low-Rank LLM Compression
candidates.abstract: As LLMs grow in size, compression becomes increasingly important for efficient deployment. SVD-based low-rank compression reduces parameter counts but can degrade downstream performance. To improve performance after compression, we introduce QuLoC, a photonic quantum-assisted LLM compression algorithm that uses quantum circuit outputs to gate the retained low-rank components during training. Model performance is recovered through local functional reconstruction followed by end-to-end knowledge distillation. After training, the gating coefficients are absorbed into the low-rank factors, allowing the compressed model to run on classical hardware without executing quantum circuits during inference. Experiments on Qwen3.5-4B show that QuLoC achieves a 9.73\% relative improvement in average accuracy over state-of-the-art baselines across multiple downstream tasks, demonstrating its effectiveness. We further evaluate QuLoC on LLaMA-7B at different parameter compression ratios. It consistently achieves higher average downstream accuracy than state-of-the-art baselines, supporting its applicability to a larger model across different compression settings. Notably, experiments using the photonic quantum hardware retain these benefits with a small accuracy loss relative to simulation, suggesting robustness to hardware noise. These results motivate further exploration of photonic quantum-assisted compression for larger models and more complex agentic tasks.
candidates.reason: LLM推論・配備時のモデル圧縮に直接関係する。SVD低ランク化したTransformer MLP投影を対象に、学習で調整するゲートと二段階再構成・蒸留で精度回復を試み、学習後はゲートを低ランク因子へ畳み込むため量子回路を実行せず古典ハードウェア上で推論できる。推論時の速度向上は測定されておらず、本分類はモデル容量・計算量を変える圧縮機構としての対象性に基づく。
candidates.library_body_check: arXiv v1本文（2026-09-30）§3.1–3.6, §4.1–4.3, §5.1–5.4, §6.4, §7を確認。QuLoCはQwen3.5-4Bの選択されたSwiGLU MLP（layers 8–23）についてgate/up/down射影をSVD初期化の低ランク因子へ置換し、入力非依存なフォトニック回路出力から得るゲインでrank channelを調整する。Stage Iで各層の機能再構成、Stage IIでQwen3.5-27B教師によるend-to-end知識蒸留を行い、学習後にゲインを因子へ吸収する。§3.6は1層あたりのdense MLP 3dm MAC/tokenに対してdeploy時は4r(d+m) MAC/tokenとし、主要線形演算量の理論上の削減率がparameter削減率に一致すると記す。Qwen3.5-4Bでは言語モデル部分のパラメータを20.05%削減した同一圧縮率比較で、WikiText-2/C4 perplexityは12.173/24.644、6タスク平均精度は54.03%; Swift-SVDの49.24%に対して4.79ポイント（相対9.73%）高い（Table 1）。評価はWikiText-2とC4の次token perplexity、およびARC-Easy, PIQA, OpenBookQA, WinoGrande, HellaSwag, MathQAのzero-shot精度。LLaMA-7Bではパラメータ保持率0.8/0.6を評価し、Swift-SVD*比の平均精度改善はそれぞれ約1ポイントで、保持率0.6ではperplexityが比較法より悪い場合もある（Table 4, §5.3）。§5.4では物理フォトニックデバイスからオフライン取得した応答プールを使う補助評価を報告し、Qwen3.5-4Bのlayers 8–23をrank 384/768で圧縮した比較で6タスク平均精度53.23%を得た（Optimized SVDは48.54%）。simulation比では平均精度が相対1.48%低下したとabstractが報告する。§6.4は未評価の推論latency/throughput、入力やhidden stateに応じて変化しないゲイン、限られたモデル・MLP層・圧縮設定、複数seedおよびhardware条件の不足を明示する。従って圧縮・精度効果の論文として対象だが、推論速度向上や広い汎用性の実証とは扱わない。

candidates.title: MoRA: MoE Pruning via Router Bias Learning and Expert Approximation
candidates.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models enable parameter scaling with limited per-token computation by activating only a small subset of experts for each token, but deploying them still requires loading the complete expert pool into memory. Structured expert pruning can effectively reduce the memory usage by removing experts. However, existing pruning methods either use expert ranking criteria that are not well aligned with model performance or rely on effective expert subset searching that is computationally expensive. Moreover, these methods typically overlook the routing-behavior redundancy among the retained experts. In this paper, we propose MoE Pruning via Router Bias Learning and Expert Approximation (MoRA), a framework for structured MoE expert pruning. We introduce a learnable router bias for each expert and optimize these biases by minimizing the language-modeling loss and a routing-diversity regularizer. The learned router biases sharpen the routing probability distributions to identify experts critical to model performance while encouraging the selection of experts with diverse routing preferences. In addition, we introduce an expert approximation mechanism as a post-pruning enhancement. It leverages the remaining experts to approximate the outputs of pruned experts by affine transformation, further improving the performance of the pruned model. We evaluate MoRA on Qwen3-30B-A3B, DeepSeek-V2-Lite, and Moonlight-16B-A3B, removing 25\% and 50\% of the routed experts in each MoE layer. Extensive experiments on nine zero-shot benchmarks show that MoRA outperforms state-of-the-art pruning algorithms. Our code will be released.
candidates.reason: 対象。MoEモデルをデプロイする際に全expertの重みを保持するメモリ負荷を、各MoE層からexpert単位で構造的に削除して軽減する推論時圧縮手法を提案する。事前学習済みrouterを固定したままexpertごとの学習可能biasをC4上の言語モデル損失とrouting-diversity正則化で校正し、そのbias上位のexpertを保持する。削除expertの出力は、保持expertをproxyとしてtoken-conditionedな重み付きridge回帰でfitしたchannel-wise affine変換により補う。Qwen3-30B-A3B、DeepSeek-V2-Lite、Moonlight-16B-A3Bの3モデルを25%/50%のrouted-expert削減率で評価し、5 pruning baselineと比べ9 zero-shot benchmarkの平均値が各設定で最良と報告する。これは圧縮・予測品質評価であり、推論レイテンシやスループット向上を実測した結果ではない。
candidates.library_body_check: arXiv HTML v1本文 (https://arxiv.org/html/2610.00367v1) を確認。§1-3では、router logitへexpert単位のlearnable biasを加えて校正コーパス上のLM lossとrouter-row cosine similarity由来のdiversity lossで最適化し、bias順に各層の保持expertを決める仕組みを確認した。§3.3ではfit/scoreに分けたC4 calibration dataから、pruned expertをretained proxyの出力からchannel-wise affine変換で近似し、weighted R² fidelityが閾値を超える場合のみ適用する手順を確認した。§4.1-4.2はQwen3-30B-A3B (48 MoE layers, 128 routed experts/layer, top-8)、DeepSeek-V2-LiteとMoonlight-16B-A3B (各26 layers, 64 routed experts/layer, top-6)を用い、C4 calibration (bias学習1000 iterations、proxy用各64 sequences×1024 tokensのfit/score split)およびlm-evaluation-harnessのBoolQ/RTE/HellaSwag/WinoGrande/PIQA/OpenBookQA/ARC-Easy/ARC-Challenge/MMLUのzero-shot評価を報告する。Tables 1-3ではMoRAの9-task平均が全モデル・両削減率で比較baseline中最高。§4.2 Table 4ではparameter数とstorageを報告し、25%削減時の元モデルからの平均score低下はQwen3 0.60、DeepSeek-V2-Lite 2.37、Moonlight 2.59ポイント、affine追加量は保持parameter数の0.08%未満、推論FLOPs追加量は元モデル比0.0005%以下と記載。§4.3 Table 5ではQwen3でLM lossとdiversity lossの併用およびexpert approximationの効果をablation。評価は3つのMoE構成と9つのzero-shot taskに限られ、50%削減では未圧縮モデルからの品質低下が大きい。本文はwall-clock latency、throughput、実測peak memoryの比較を示さず、コードは公開予定と記す。
